name: Backslashbar
description: Two leaning bars crossing, one over the other.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; right: 8%; top: 44%; height: 12%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-transform: rotate(45deg); transform: rotate(45deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; right: 8%; top: 44%; height: 12%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(-45deg); transform: rotate(-45deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
